title: Revert rejected container updates and skip no-op pids updates
body:
`podman update` kept limits the runtime rejected, so the container could not start again. Roll the config back when the runtime update fails.

On rootless cgroupfs, an unlimited pids update on a container with no limit (including every `docker update`, which sends `PidsLimit: 0`) failed with "controller `pids` is not available". Skip it, since there is nothing to change.

Follow-up to #29910.

```release-note
Fixed a bug where a failed `podman update` left the rejected limits in the container's configuration, preventing it from starting. Unlimited pids updates no longer fail when running rootless with cgroupfs.
```
